feedback.problem:
If $B=[\begin{aligned}2x & 5x-1 \\ 4 & -2\end{aligned}]$
is a singular matrix, calculate the value of $x.$

$x=$
{{field-1}}
feedback.worked_solution:
The matrix $B$ is singular if and only if $det(B)=0.$ Calculating the determinant, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}det(B) & =(2x)\cdot (-2)-4\cdot (5x-1) \\  & =-4x+4-20x \\  & =-24x+4.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we set the determinant equal to $0$ and solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}-24x+4 & =0 \\ 24x & =4 \\ x & =\frac{4}{24} \\ x & =\frac{1}{6}\end{aligned}
$$
